class ip_process.ip_utils.ip_handler.IPHandler[source]

Bases: object

handle_ip(ip: str)[source]

Processes the IP address by validating it and, if it is a public IP, updating or creating an IP instance in the database. Only public IP addresses are stored.

Parameters:

ip – The IP address as a string.

Returns:

The IP model instance if handled successfully, otherwise None.

validate_ip(ip: str) → str | None[source]

Validates an IP address and determines its type.

Parameters:

ip – The IP address to validate.

Returns:

A string indicating the IP type (e.g., ‘Public IPv4’, ‘Private IPv6’) or None if the IP is invalid.
